ork permission decisions, before and after the ASK gate

--dangerously-skip-permissions switches off Claude Code's own permission engine. It does not switch off a PreToolUse hook that answers ask, so every ork confirmation prompt survived the flag. Pick a mode, type a command, and compare.

The old rule was one unqualified match on kill|pkill|killall. The new one asks about force and breadth, and allows precision. Decisions below are shown for a default-mode session, where the bypass gate does not apply.
